zh-CN.title: 群聊提醒更懂轻重
items: 消息通知与 WebAPP 未读状态不再互相影响
可将群聊未读数字弱化为小红点
群聊支持 @成员，并在会话列表保留被提及标识

en.title: Smarter group chat attention
items: External notifications are now independent from WebAPP unread state
Group unread counts can be de-emphasized into a quiet dot
Mention group members and keep a clear mention marker in the chat list
